verified_facts.text: Hayman Island sits at the northernmost point of the Whitsunday archipelago in Australia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hayman Island is nestled at the northernmost point of Australia

verified_facts.text: The Infinity Pool overlooks the Coral Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: an Infinity Pool overlooking the Coral Sea

verified_facts.text: The Hayman Pool is the largest saltwater pool in the southern hemisphere.
verified_facts.excerpt: the iconic Hayman Pool which is the largest saltwater pool in the southern hemisphere

verified_facts.text: The Hayman Residences on the island hillside were designed by Australian architect Kerry Hill and offer panoramic views across the Whitsundays.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by multi-award-winning Australian Architect Kerry Hill, all Residences offer panoramic views across The Whitsundays.

verified_facts.text: Accommodation ranges across rooms, suites, pavilions, villas, residences and the three-bedroom Hayman Beach House.
verified_facts.excerpt: beautifully-appointed rooms, suites, pavilions, villas, residences and the three-bedroom Hayman Beach House

verified_facts.text: Hayman Spa has treatment rooms, a couples' room, and sauna and steam facilities set in the natural surrounds of Hayman Island.
verified_facts.excerpt: a couples' room, sauna and steam facilities nestled in the natural surrounds of Hayman Island

verified_facts.text: The resort offers helicopter adventures over Heart Reef and helicopter tours over Whitehaven Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: offers bespoke helicopter adventures that take you high above the world-famous Heart Reef, and exhilarating helicopter tours over Whitehaven Beach and beyond

verified_facts.text: Guests can travel by resort speedboat to Langford Island, where a sand spit at low tide gives access to fringing coral reefs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Travel by resort speedboat to Langford Island and spend a couple of hours exploring this natural wonder.

verified_facts.text: Pacific, the resort's signature restaurant and bar, is on the beachfront in the Central Lanai.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pacific is located on the beachfront in the Central Lanai

verified_facts.text: Poolside Cabanas near the Infinity Pool and Hayman Pool offer ocean views and sundeck space.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Poolside Cabanas are an ideal private abode with contemporary comfort, ocean views, and sundeck space

verified_facts.text: The fitness centre has a dedicated group fitness area offering Pilates, yoga and meditation classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: a dedicated group fitness area offering Pilates, yoga, and meditation classes

verified_facts.text: The resort has an indoor golf simulator.
verified_facts.excerpt: state of the art indoor golf simulator

verified_facts.text: The resort is located in a national park, so no pets are permitted; guide dogs and service animals are exempt.
verified_facts.excerpt: As InterContinental Hayman Great Barrier Reef is located in a national park, no pets are permitted at the Resort.

verified_facts.text: The nearest airport is Hamilton Island - Great Barrier Reef Airport, about 35 kilometers from the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: conveniently located near Hamilton Island - Great Barrier Reef Airport (HTI), approximately 21.75 miles away (35 kilometers) from the hotel

verified_facts.text: The resort is a single-use plastic free hotel.
Babysitting, a nanny for hire and children's activities are available.
